name: Associated Alcohols & Breweries Ltd
about: Associated Alcohols & Breweries Ltd is in business of manufacturing and trading of ENA, Indian Made Indian Liquor (Country Liquor), Indian Made Foreign Liquor and Hand sanitizer.[1]
keyPoints:
Market Leadership
The company is a prominent player in the liquor industry, with a significant presence in Madhya Pradesh, holding a 20-25% market share in IMIL and IMFL products. Additionally, it ranks among the top 5 IMFL players in Kerala and is the world's first producer of White Brandy. [1] [2]

pros: Promoter holding has increased by 1.93% over last quarter.
cons: Dividend payout has been low at 5.31% of profits over last 3 years
